content.text: Let me test via vitest instead and clean up the build output.

input.command:
git status --short; git clean -fdxq packages/*/dist 2>/dev/null; cat > packages/compiler-sfc/__tests__/tmp.spec.ts <<'EOF'
import { compileStyle } from '../src'
test('x', () => {
  console.log(compileStyle({source:`.foo { background-color: red; .bar {} @media only screen and (max-width: 800px) { background-color: green; .bar{color:red} } }`,filename:'a.css',id:'data-v-test',scoped:true}).code)
})
EOF
npx vitest run packages/compiler-sfc/__tests__/tmp.spec.ts 2>&1 | grep -v '^$' | head -30; rm packages/compiler-sfc/__tests__/tmp.spec.ts; npx vitest run packages/compiler-sfc 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests|FAIL"; git status --short
